rationale: Lexeme unattested; context with ⲛⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ 'archons' and ⲉⲩⲥⲛⲣ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'spread out' suggests a collective/dispersive noun. Possibly Greek χορός or Lyc. cognate of ⲥⲱⲣ 'scatter.' Flag for parallels in subsequent pages.
Possibly Lyc. ϩⲱⲡ/ϩⲏⲡ 'judgment, hidden thing' or ⲥⲉⲡ 'occasion.' The construction 'the X that you (Living Spirit) have done' supports a noun for accomplished action. Reduplicated -ⲡⲡ unclear.
Verb in line 16 paired with ⲭⲉⲥⲧ 'convey upward' as the action that prepares the gods/angels for ascent. Tentative; awaiting parallel attestations.
Context (with ⲣⲱⲭⲍ̄ 'burn' and 'fire') points to a heating-vessel; possibly a metallurgical or refining implement. Etymology unclear.

Used here in proximity to ⲧⲁⲣⲕⲟⲩ 'make swear' (line 23) — suggests ⲡⲱⲣⲕ = 'swear an oath' (= Sah. ⲱⲣⲕ̄). Alternative reading 'uproot, draw out' (= ⲡⲱⲣⲕ̄) also possible in metallurgical/agricultural context.
Coptic loanword for axe/cleaver, used as the implement for cutting down the bitter trees in the soteriological-agricultural metaphor.
Lyc. reflex of Greek λαός 'people, nation.' Used here for 'this people' to whom the likeness of Jesus came.
